transcript.line: A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 3× unknown nuts, 4× unknown roots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
★ IDENTIFIED: Hickory Nuts. Hickory nut. Hard shell, sweet meat. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

Pork is pork. Smoke it; it keeps for weeks. The quills make excellent awls. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
On the carcass nearby, Bulldozer (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.
💡 KNOWLEDGE COMBINES: Hickory Nuts — Level 2. You knew it was safe. the village knew the rest. Together, it's deeper. Parts: nut meat (eat), shells (smoke flavor), bark (tea). Crack carefully.
